summary: Implemented T-003 (Cmd+Opt+N note overview) end to end mirroring the edit_group_note pattern: new toggle_note_overview keybind action through the Zig core (Binding.zig enum + surface scope + parse test, apprt/action.zig union + Key appended last for C ABI, Surface.zig dispatch, command.zig no-palette list, Config.zig default cmd+opt+n — verified unbound in defaults and menu xibs) and the C header (XGHOSTTY_ACTION_TOGGLE_NOTE_OVERVIEW appended last; enum-sync machine-checked by zig test), then Swift: XGhostty.App dispatch -> ghosttyToggleNoteOverview notification -> BaseTerminalController (resigns surface first responder on entry) -> WorkspaceModel.toggleNoteOverview. Model layer owns every §S-012 judgment: noteOverviewActive (transient, never persisted), entry releases zoom BEFORE showing and never changes focusedGroup, display set noteOverviewGroupIDs == WorkspaceState.visibleGroupIDs (canonical leaves = visible groups; hidden excluded), viewing-only guards (beginNoteEditing*, gotoGroupTarget, gotoGroupIndexTarget, switchFocusedGroup all no-op while active), toggle no-op while the note editor is open, restoreState/removeAllGroups end the mode. UI: per-group read-only GroupNoteOverviewOverlay inside each visible GroupView (lineLimit(maxNoteLines)+tail truncation in a group-bounded frame so layout never breaks; full text remains the edit overlay's job) plus workspace-level GroupNoteOverviewKeyCatcher (blocks the mouse; Esc via focused-field onExitCommand; re-pressed Cmd+Opt+N re-matched by a hidden keyboardShortcut button because SurfaceView.performKeyEquivalent ignores events while unfocused); exit hands first responder back to the terminal. 14 new model tests in GroupNoteTests.
verification: zig build (body of just build-app, R-002 workaround) exit 0; just test exit 0 (includes checkXGhosttyHEnum header-sync and the new parse test); just swift-test exit 0, TEST SUCCEEDED, 434 tests incl. the 14 new note-overview tests. T-003 marked done with command+diff evidence via apply-projection (validation ok); visual confirmation remains T-006 (human, on-device).
decisions: restoreState (undo/redo) ends the overview rather than preserving it, so a restored snapshot's zoom can never contradict the mode's zoom-released invariant.
toggleNoteOverview is a no-op while the note editor is open: the editor owns the keyboard and its draft must not be silently dropped.

The overview's exit chord (Cmd+Opt+N) is re-matched by a hidden SwiftUI keyboardShortcut button hardcoded to the default binding; a user-rebound toggle_note_overview key would exit only via Esc — acceptable for the single-author product, worth a look at T-006.
